;Law and crime
*[[Musharraf high treason case]]
**Former [[President of Pakistan]] [[Pervez Musharraf]] is [[capital punishment in Pakistan|sentenced to death]] ''[[trial in absentia|in absentia]]'' for [[high treason]], by a 2-1 majority. He is described as a [[dictator]] who seized power in a [[1999 Pakistani coup d'état|1999 coup]], imposed a [[Pakistani state of emergency, 2007|2007 state of emergency]] and resigned in 2008 to avoid [[Movement to impeach Pervez Musharraf|impeachment]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/12/17/asia/pervez-musharraf-death-sentence-pakistan-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pakistan-law-musharraf/pakistan-sentences-former-dictator-musharraf-to-death-in-absentia-idUSKBN1YL0MJ (Reuters)]
*[[2016–present purges in Turkey]]
**[[Turkish police]] arrest 191 people, including a mayor, accused of links with the [[Gülen movement]] (named by Turkey as FETÖ, a terrorist group) and of using [[ByLock (application)|ByLock]], an encrypted messaging application.
